title: IAM Graph Export
description: Output of Person 1 (Parser & Graph Builder). Consumed by Person 2 (Detection Engine) and Person 4 (Dashboard).

accounts.description: List of AWS account IDs present in this export.

nodes.description: All IAM principals, policies, and resources as graph nodes.

id.description: Full ARN of the entity, or service principal URI (e.g. ec2.amazonaws.com).

account_id.description: AWS account ID owning this node. Use 'unknown' for synthetic/external nodes.

name.description: Human-readable short name (username, role name, policy name, etc.).

attached_policies.description: ARNs of managed policies directly attached to this principal.

is_admin_equivalent.description: True if this principal's effective permissions include *:* or AdministratorAccess is attached. Pre-computed by Person 1.

source.description: ARN or identifier of the source node (the principal gaining permission).

target.description: ARN or identifier of the target node (the resource/role being accessed).

permission.description: Fixed enum of edge permission types.

condition.description: IAM condition block from the policy statement, or null if unconditional.

is_wildcard_resource.description: True if the source policy statement has Resource: * for this permission.
